+def _is_seed_subject_string(seed: str) -> TypeGuard[SeedSubjectString]:
+    return seed.startswith(_SUBJECT_SEED_PREFIXES)

+def _subject_key_to_seed(key: str) -> SeedSubjectString:
+    key = key.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+    if not _is_seed_subject_string(key):
+        key = f"subject:{key}"
+    key = key.replace(",", "_")
+    while "__" in key:
+        key = key.replace("__", "_")
+    return SeedSubjectString(key)
+
+
+def _normalize_seed(seed: StoredSeed) -> SeedDict | SeedSubjectString:
+    if isinstance(seed, Thing):
+        key = seed.key
+    elif isinstance(seed, str):
+        if seed.startswith("/") and not seed.startswith("/subjects/"):
+            return {"key": seed}
+        return _subject_key_to_seed(seed)
+    elif isinstance(seed, dict):
+        key = seed["key"]
+    else:
+        key = seed.key
+
+    if key.startswith("/subjects/") or _is_seed_subject_string(key):
+        return _subject_key_to_seed(key)
+    return {"key": key}
+
+
+def _seed_subject_key(seed: StoredSeed) -> str:
+    normalized_seed = _normalize_seed(seed)
+    if isinstance(normalized_seed, str):
+        return str(normalized_seed)
+    return normalized_seed["key"]
+
